verse.verse_1: Certainly the news of the calamity that will overwhelm has come to you!
verse.verse_2: Many a face will be disgraced on that day.
verse.verse_5: Made to drink water from the boiling hot spring.
verse.verse_6: There is no food for them except thorns of fire.
verse.verse_7: Which neither give strength nor satisfy the hunger.
verse.verse_8: Many a face will be in serenity on that day.
verse.verse_11: In which they will not hear any lewd speech.
verse.verse_12: In it is a flowing spring.
verse.verse_17: So do they not see the camel – how it has been created?
verse.verse_18: And the heaven – how it has been raised?
verse.verse_19: And the mountains – how they have been established?
verse.verse_20: And the earth – how it has been spread out?
verse.verse_21: Therefore advise; indeed you are a proclaimer of advice. (The Holy Prophet is a Remembrance from Allah.)
verse.verse_22: You are not at all a guardian over them.
verse.verse_23: Except whoever turns away and disbelieves –
verse.verse_24: So Allah will mete out to him the greatest punishment.
verse.verse_25: Indeed only towards Us is their return
verse.verse_26: Then indeed only upon Us is their reckoning.
